reviews.comment:
Buenas instalaciones. Cometieron un error con mi tarjeta de ypf en ruta y me demoraron más de una hora, para subsanar un problema de ellos en la gestión.
Entiendo que errar es humano, pero no escucharon mi sugerencia para solucionarlo mas rápido por internet con un simple celular de los actuales. Tuve que esperar que un bendito 0800 los atendiera.Lo demás muy bueno, siempre acudo al ACA, por combustible, hosterías, moteles, etc.

(Translated by Google)
Good facilities. They made a mistake with my YPF card while I was on the road and it took them over an hour to fix a problem they had with their system.

I understand that to err is human, but they didn't listen to my suggestion to resolve it more quickly online with a simple modern cell phone. I had to wait for a blessed 0800 number to answer. Otherwise, everything was very good; I always go to the ACA for fuel, hotels, motels, etc.

reviews.comment:
El lugar es muy lindo, parquizado, baños limpios y con jabón y papel higiénico; el shop con aire acondicionado, wifi, mesas para comer, con las medidas sanitarias requeridas Anti covid, bastante completo en cuanto  comidas, bebidas y snacks, lo único que los que lo atienden no tienen buena predisposición, mala cara y pocas ganas de atender...

(Translated by Google)
The place is very nice, with landscaping, clean bathrooms with soap and toilet paper; the shop has air conditioning, Wi-Fi, tables for eating, and the required anti-Covid sanitary measures are in place. It's quite complete in terms of food, drinks, and snacks. The only problem is that the staff are unhelpful, have a sour face, and seem unwilling to serve customers.
